content.text: Experience the best of Meghalaya with our Shillong Sightseeing Tour. Visit and explore the top attractions like Don Bosco Museum, Elephant Falls, Shillong Peak, Ward's Lake, Botanical Garden, Shillong Golf Course and Lady Hydari Park. This tour is perfect for everyone who is looking to witness both cultural and scenic beauty of Shillong.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Explore Shillong, the “Scotland of the East"
Visit Don Bosco Museum, Elephant Falls, Shillong Peak, Ward's Lake and Botanical Garden.
Enjoy nature at Shillong Golf Course and Lady Hydari Park.
Your Shillong Sightseeing Tour will begin with the exploration of Shillong City, often referred to as the ‘Scotland of the East’, along with its scenic surrounding areas.
This tour package covers all the major places of Shillong, ensuring a complete experience of this charming city.

As a part of your Shillong Sightseeing Tour, you will visit popular attractions such as Don Bosco Museum where you will discover more about the Northeast's indigenous civilizations. Get a glimpse of the clothing, tools, and artefacts that the native tribes of the northeastern states used as you explore the museum. For a broad perspective of Shillong, you can tour the Skywalk as well.

Our next spot will be the breathtaking Elephant Falls. It is a well-known destination and a three-step waterfall. It was named for an elephant-shaped boulder that can be seen at the base of the Falls and is renowned for its beauty.
Next, we'll visit Shillong Peak. It provides a panoramic view of the stunning city of Shillong. If you're fortunate enough, you can also witness the worth watching sunset from this location.

Meghalaya's capital city is home to several other fantastic tourist attractions, such as Ward's Lake, which is well-liked for boating and quick garden walks. This wonderful destination would be your next stop.
Further, you'll be exploring the Botanical Garden and witness some wonderful species of orchids spending a relaxing time as well.

After a relaxing visit to Botanical Garden, we will explore and visit Shillong Golf Course which is among the largest and oldest Golf Courses in India. It is an 18-hole Golf Course nestled amidst thick pine groves and rhododendron trees.

Our last stop would be Lady Hydari Park which is a wonderful park with long expanses of roses and other lovely blooms. A Mini Zoo with over 70 birds, 135 animals, and reptiles is another feature of the park.
After a wonderful excursion, our cab will drop you off at your respective hotel in Shillong, concluding your Shillong Sightseeing Tour.
